g.text: The capabilities placed in one framework, laid out in the framework's own terms: BIAN's business areas and domains, ITIL's groups of practices, the CRI Profile's functions. It is drawn for
every framework something is placed in, including one an organization adds. A capability placed twice in one framework is drawn at its first placement, and its details list every one.
